# pbs_verify_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the verify jobs of a Proxmox Backup Server, with the attributes of `pbs_verify_job`: those on whose datastore, or namespace, the provider's user or token has `Datastore.Audit` or `Datastore.Verify`; PBS leaves the others out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_verify_jobs" "store1" {
  store = "store1"
}

# Every datastore should be verified on a schedule.
check "store1_is_verified" {
  assert {
    condition     = anytrue([for j in data.pbs_verify_jobs.store1.jobs : j.schedule != null])
    error_message = "No verify job checks the backups of store1 on a schedule."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `store` (String) List only the jobs of this datastore, such as `store1`: those whose `store` it is.

### Read-Only

- `jobs` (Attributes List) The verify jobs, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `id` (String) Job ID, such as `verify-store1`.
- `ignore_verified` (Boolean) Whether the job skips backups verified before, unless that verification is older than `outdated_after`.
- `max_depth` (Number) How many levels of namespaces below `ns` the job verifies too; 7 for all of them.
- `ns` (String) Namespace the job verifies; null for the datastore's root namespace.
- `outdated_after` (Number) How many days after its last verification a backup is verified again; null for never.
- `read_threads` (Number) How many threads read chunks; null when the datastore's default applies.
- `schedule` (String) When the job runs, as a PBS calendar event; null when it runs only when started by hand.
- `store` (String) Datastore the job verifies.
- `verify_threads` (Number) How many threads verify chunks; null when the datastore's default applies.
